ga4Id.title: Google Analytics 4 measurement id
ga4Id.description: G-XXXXXXX. Loads only after the visitor consents to analytics.

adsId.title: Google Ads id
adsId.description: AW-XXXXXXXXX. Loads only after the visitor consents to marketing. Which events are Google Ads conversions, with which label, is the list Conversion actions.

gtmId.title: Google Tag Manager container id
gtmId.description: GTM-XXXXXXX. Loads after the visitor consents to analytics or marketing; Consent Mode tells its tags what was granted.

ga4ViaGtm.title: Google Analytics 4 runs inside Tag Manager
ga4ViaGtm.description: On: Growth does not load Google Analytics itself; your Tag Manager container's Google Analytics tag takes the events from the dataLayer, so they are counted once. Needs the Tag Manager container id.
